guidelines.detail: refines GW-06 (The description distinguishes an unconditional action from an action required only when applicable, and the reference includes an inclusive gateway for these actions. This makes the broader inclusive-gateway guidance more specific to mixed required and conditional follow-up actions.)

documentation rule COL-07 not applied (The description assigns work to internal roles or a department, while also describing contact with external organizations. The records show missing reference lanes and an extra generated pool, consistent with confusion between internal responsibility and external participants. COL-07 already advises against representing ordinary internal roles as separate pools; LANE-01 likewise directs using lane)

The gateway recorded as missing has a generated counterpart at the same point: a parallel gateway between packaging and pickup preparation (G20, G21). The description says the goods can be packaged while other work is underway and pickup preparation starts when things are ready (S7), so this convergence must wait for both concurrent branches. A parallel join is appropriate; the reference exclusive gateway joining those paths (M1, F2, F5, F6) would not synchronize them correctly. The applicable modeling idea is already captured by LRN-036, so these records do not support proposing a new guideli

same as LRN-024 (The description specifies that the clarification concerns who will carry out the work, while the reference label changes that meaning. This is already covered by LRN-024, which requires task labels to preserve the stated action and distinguishing details.)

refines LANE-02 (The description links the continuation to work explicitly performed by warehouse staff, while the reference places that continuation in the Warehouse lane and the generated model places it in the Secretary lane. This refines LANE-02 by clarifying how to assign responsibility when a dependent continuation has no separately named performer.)

same as LRN-022 (The records show a missing exclusive decision and case-specific paths, with the paths leading back to a shared continuation. The description supports this structure, and it is consistent with BPMN semantics; LRN-022 already covers modeling mutually exclusive outcomes with separate gateway paths.)

same as LRN-024 (The generated labels for the shipping clarification, amount condition, and company selection reflect the description, while the corresponding reference labels differ or add unsupported meaning. This supports preserving the description’s semantics in labels rather than reproducing a divergent reference label. The guideline is essentially the same as learned rule LRN-024.)

refines FID-01 (The description explicitly states a preparation action, and the reference includes an activity for it while the generated model does not. This refines FID-01 by specifying how to model preparation for a later handoff. The extra collaboration elements are consistent with COL-01, so they do not support advising against those participants or messages.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description lists multiple follow-up actions, with one required and another performed only when needed: Model the actions as branches from an inclusive gateway, activating the conditional branch only when applicable.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description lists multiple follow-up actions, with one required and another performed only when needed

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description gives an activity together with contextual or implementation details: label the corresponding BPMN element with its core action and object, omitting details that do not distinguish the activity.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity or decision together with its purpose, outcome, or distinguishing condition

rules_sent_back.instruction: Do not create separate pools for ordinary internal roles unless the description treats them as independent communicating participants.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description identifies work performed by internal roles or departments and also describes interactions with external organizations

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states an activity together with a purpose, object, or scope that distinguishes what is being done: Label the corresponding BPMN task with its core action and enough of those stated details to preserve the activity’s meaning; do not add unsupported details or omit details that distinguish it.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states a specific aspect that an activity is meant to clarify or perform, distinguishing it from related aspects

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description assigns an activity to a role and then describes a dependent continuation of that work without naming a different responsible role: Place the continuation in the same role’s lane unless the description assigns it to another role.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description assigns an activity to a role and then describes a dependent continuation of that work without naming a different responsible role

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description identifies mutually exclusive outcomes for a process decision.: Model an exclusive decision gateway with a separate outgoing path for each stated outcome, and ensure each path reaches its appropriate terminal outcome.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description distinguishes mutually exclusive cases that require different actions before a shared continuation

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that an item is made ready for collection or handoff after other work is complete: Model the preparation as an activity in the responsible participant’s process.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that an item is made ready for collection or handoff after other work is complete
